{{Top}}
{{Quote|There are sublieutenants among your ranks who would cheerfully wipe out entire planets to be given such an opportunity as you all have been given.|Prince Xizor, to his Vigos|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
'''Sublieutenant''', or '''sub-lieutenant''', was the military title given to [[Ensign/Legends|ensigns]] undergoing command training. "Sublieutenant" was also the name of the rank below [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] in the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate. The [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] crime organization called the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump Gang]] also used this rank.
